steps.instruction: This request is only a rename of Todo.done to Todo.completed, so list() must behave exactly as it did before. Do not change how list() filters todos by default. The acceptance test that failed last round assumed list() hides completed todos by default. That assumption was mine, not part of the request, and I have replaced the test. No source change should be needed. Make sure every read or write of the old field now uses `completed`, with no leftover `done` property and no `any` casts that hide it. Keep the ListOptions.includeDone name and its semantics as they are.
